program_source:
def task():
    acquire("left", "tool_beta")
    wait("left", 40000000)
    release("left", "tool_beta")
    acquire("right", "tool_beta")
    wait("right", 40000000)
    release("right", "tool_beta")
brief_author_note: The program gives the shared tool to the left arm for a timed work turn, releases it, then gives it to the right arm for a timed work turn and releases it.
